docs.summary: Manages the quadtree LOD system for terrain rendering. Simple distance-based subdivision with a quality multiplier. Each view keeps its own tree, so its hysteresis follows that view's camera.

docs.summary: Updates the quadtree based on camera position.

params.lodQuality: Quality multiplier for LOD distance thresholds. 1.0 = default, higher = more detail (subdivides further from camera), lower = less detail.
